title: Derek Smith's Good Morning America story
summary: A story about Derek Smith being asked to accompany on Good Morning America with no music, ending back at Pavarotti.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: Derek Smith tells this great story about that do you remember? He got called to do Good Morning America. He got home it was on his answer machine or something. So to accompany him. And he showed up real early and he was like oh my God, no one would give him any music. Finally he says well talk to his manager. It was like three minutes before airtime. And he says oh, yeah, okay. So he gives him the piece and it’s like “Deck the Halls” or something. It was a Christmas tune. He was all like, oh, I’m going to have to play something.
It’s got to be at least Tosca. Is that the weirdest thing?
Luciano Pavarotti. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -18-
